verdict.rationale: Framer's docs show animated, interactive behavior: animated menus, interactive carousels, sticky navbars, and motion and effects applied across a site. A community user also calls it great for advanced prototyping with animations and transitions. Community reports of occasional animation stutter and shape distortion affect polish but do not refute the capability. Missing for 10: documented state-to-state animation, conditions/variables logic, explicit scroll-triggered effects, and in-depth first-party prototyping docs.

support.subject: As a designer, prototypes can carry advanced behavior — animation between states, conditions or variables, scroll effects — to feel like the real product

citations.quote: Sticky navbars, animated menus, interactive carousels, just describe what you want. The agent handles the wiring
The agent takes care of colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects across your site.
Framer is great for more advanced prototyping needs w/ animations/transitions/etc
